title: GatorBait Magazine - Ole Miss Pregame Issue
coverDeck: Eighteen years after The Promise, Ole Miss walks back into The Swamp.
colophon: GatorBait Media, Gainesville, Florida. Every article in this issue was reported and published by the GatorBait newsroom. This issue is complete as printed and contains no links. Florida (3-0, 1-0 SEC) hosts No. 4 Ole Miss on Saturday, September 26, at 3:30 p.m. on ABC in The Swamp.
